name: dev-flow
description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, a sub-agent dev cycle that carries one change from plan to merge, multi-agent research fan-outs, a research skill family that turns a question into sourced, verified findings and a curated knowledge base (with the research-lane and research-verifier agents), chain-of-verification fact-checking, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependencies: work-items; statusline-hub, for rate-limit reset times and the research skills' quota read from the sensor record it writes; context-guard, for checkpoint and rehydration; kit-dev, whose update-kit takes the retrospective findings).
